notes.title: The Hardwater update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43728083/48e497f2c8892d9ae02a130bf6919bfb0bd837b4.jpg"][/img]Today’s update fixes some lingering bugs described by the user Hardwater (thanks Hardwater!)[/p][p]-Fixed enemy squadmates not seeing you after you are revived[/p][p]-Fixed a spelling error (“moral coil”→”mortal coil”) - I could have SWORN I fixed it in previous updates, but guess not[/p][p] -Fixed a crash during missions[/p][p] -Fixed enemy squadmates floating in the air near their dropship after it flies away (dead bodies will still float though.. for now)[/p]
